name: ResolveAI
problem: Support teams spend too much time answering repetitive questions while customers wait for clear, trustworthy answers.
persona: Mid-market SaaS customers and support agents handling repetitive product and policy questions.
promise: ResolveAI gives customers fast, source-grounded answers and routes uncertain cases to a human without hiding uncertainty.
mvp: Source-cited AI answers, confidence-gated escalation, agent handoff, feedback capture, evaluation dashboard, and launch scorecard.
non_goals: Autonomous refunds, account changes, legal advice, unrestricted actions, and replacing human support for complex cases.
north_star: Resolved Customer Sessions (RCS): sessions where the user gets a correct answer or a successful human handoff without reopening the same issue.
success_targets: ≥70% resolution rate; ≥90% groundedness on evaluation set; <5% high-severity hallucination rate; ≥4.2/5 CSAT; ≥20% support-ticket deflection.
